title: Figure 5: Wigner function of a squeezed vacuum and quadrature noise trace
description: Top: 3D wireframe surface plot of an elongated ridge-shaped Wigner function. Bottom: scatter plot of Noise current [a.u.] versus Time [ms] from 0 to 200, showing periodically pinched bands of dense points. Caption reads "Figure 5. Wigner Function of a Squeezed Vacuum. Wigner function (top) and quadrature fluctuations (bottom)," credited to Ulf Leonhardt.
